# Frozen Barnette producer texts and conditional application interfaces

The two producer source hashes match the earlier indexed contribution. The lemma states the disjoint square supports, degree-one/two pattern, terminal count 0/2/4 and connectivity explicitly. The upstream interface review records conditional application assumptions and a hand-described 26-vertex profile example; it does not establish the entire application chain or refute Barnette.

This artifact-check review is inconclusive about mathematical validity. It preserves sources, their documented corrections and their limitations; it does not add a theorem, authenticate all upstream interfaces or supersede the existing RESULT.

- The Statement/Proof of the square-splicing lemma is self-contained within its stated hypotheses.
- Notes 176/403/404/410/458/773/914 are unbundled historical application context, not verified public premises.
- The 26-vertex example concerns an overstrong automatic-profile inference; its graph properties were not independently rerun here.
- Same-model fresh-context checking is not human or heterogeneous peer acceptance.

Confirmed self-owned text and data: CC BY 4.0. Code: Apache-2.0. Human contribution credit: Li Hongmin. AI roles are disclosed in RIGHTS-AND-ATTRIBUTION.json. Archived source or checkpoint permission wording describes a historical state; this edition has current publication authorization.
